Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules

Class ImageSourceValidationRule

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.ImageSourceValidationRule
All Implemented Interfaces:
AuditRule
public final class ImageSourceValidationRule extends Object implements AuditRule
AuditRule that validates every <img> on a rendered HTML page actually resolved and loaded — catching broken relative paths, missing local files, and dead remote image URLs that render as broken-image icons in a recipient's inbox.

Why this matters

AltTextValidationRule (or the equivalent alt-text rule in this codebase) only confirms that an alt attribute is present and non-empty — it says nothing about whether the src the image points to actually exists. A typo'd folder name (e.g. src="vvvv/logo.png" instead of src="images/logo.png") passes alt-text validation cleanly while rendering as a broken image for every recipient. This rule closes that gap.

Detection approach

Rather than re-implementing scheme-specific probing (HTTP HEAD for http(s)://, filesystem existence checks for file://, and so on — the same audit engine may be pointed at either a deployed URL or a local HTML file on disk, per page.url()), this rule reads the outcome directly from the browser: once an <img> has finished attempting to load, img.complete === true and img.naturalWidth === 0 together are the DOM's own signal that the image failed to load, regardless of what scheme or path caused the failure. This works uniformly for http://, https://, file://, and relative paths, with no separate network client needed, and reflects exactly what the image looks like in a real rendered page — the same thing a recipient's mail client would show.

Checks performed

For every <img> with a non-empty src attribute:

  • Broken image — the image finished loading (complete === true) but has naturalWidth === 0, meaning the browser could not decode any image data from the resolved src.

Inline data: URIs are included in the same check — a malformed base64 payload will also report naturalWidth === 0 once the browser fails to decode it, so no separate handling is needed.

PASS evidence

When the rule passes, it also returns one evidence finding per successfully loaded image via FindingFormatter.linkFinding(), so the dashboard can show exactly which images were reviewed, e.g.:

 Image Source Validation
   Displayed Text  : Join now
   Destination     : https://example.com/images/join_now_cta.png
   Validation      : PASSED
   Reason          : Image loaded successfully

DOM and Playwright usage

Waits for LoadState.LOAD before evaluating, so every image has had a chance to finish (successfully or not) attempting to load. Image data, resolved src, and load state are all read in a single Page.evaluate(String) round-trip.

Thread safety

This class is stateless and has no mutable fields. It is safe for concurrent use from multiple TestNG threads, each operating on its own Page.
